narrative.summary: The East African Community's main AI text is the EAC Declaration on Artificial Intelligence, issued in Kigali on 1 April 2026 by EAC ministers responsible for science, technology and innovation, ICT, education and EAC affairs. In fifteen resolutions, ministers resolve to develop national AI policies aligned with an EAC AI strategy and to support an EAC AI Alliance, a regional centre of excellence and AI fund, shared compute and data infrastructure, and harmonised regional data governance. No official text of the regional AI strategy referred to in the declaration has been found.

Published in the official conference proceedings of the East African Science and Technology Commission (EASTECO), an EAC institution, with IUCEA.
instruments.scope: EAC Partner States: national AI policies and regional AI cooperation.
instruments.summary: Ministerial declaration with fifteen resolutions on AI for the East African Community. Ministers resolve to support the development of national AI policies, frameworks and strategies aligned with the regional strategy and to promote responsible, ethical and inclusive AI governance; support the EAC AI Alliance; establish an EAC Regional Centre of Excellence for Emerging Technologies and a Regional AI Technologies Fund; strengthen AI skills, develop shared compute and data infrastructure and establish harmonised regional data governance frameworks; and support local datasets and African-language models.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Ministerial commitments on a regional AI governance agenda for the East African Community.

instruments.evidence_reference: Read: the EASTECO/IUCEA proceedings 'Artificial Intelligence for a Resilient, Inclusive and Innovative East Africa' (4th EAC Regional STI Conference), read at offsets 0, 200000 and 300000: declaration title 'EAC DECLARATION ON ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE'; 'meeting in Kigali, Republic of Rwanda, on the occasion of the 4th EAC STI Conference 1st April, 2026'; fifteen resolutions after 'Hereby resolve to'; executive summary: 'presented and endorsed by EAC ICT, STI and MEACA ministers'. Foreword also calls it 'the Kigali Declaration on AI for East Africa'. Found via site:eac.int search (discovery via techafricanews). | Independent check 2026-11-08: No eac.int copy exists that search could find. EASTECO is an EAC semi-autonomous institution established under the EAC Treaty and published the proceedings with IUCEA (also an EAC institution), so it is an acceptable official source; the document is the declaration text itself, not a press release. Fixes: authority_type to convention; summary dropped 'risk-based' (not found in the resolution list read) and aligned to the 15 resolutions; current_status reworded (no 'eleventh plenary' or 30 Mar date confirmed in my read; removed research-log wording). Date 2026-04-01 as printed. applies_to: 'members'; proceedings name Partner States Burundi, DR Congo, Kenya, Rwanda, Somalia, South Sudan, Tanzania, Uganda.
